story: Liu Yu had risen from poverty to command the Eastern Jin armies. He crushed the usurper Huan Xuan in 404, conquered Southern Yan in 410 and Later Qin in 417. By then the Jin emperors were puppets.

In 418 Liu Yu had Emperor An strangled and set up his brother, Emperor Gong. In 420 Emperor Gong abdicated, and Liu Yu became Emperor Wu of a new dynasty called Song, usually called Liu Song to tell it apart from the later Song of 960. He tried to curb the great families and gave more posts to men of humble birth. He died in 422, and his son Emperor Wen's long reign, the Yuanjia era, was a time of relative prosperity.
story_zh: 刘裕出身寒微，后来统领东晋军队。他在404年击败篡位的桓玄，410年灭南燕，417年灭后秦。此时东晋皇帝已经沦为傀儡。
418年，刘裕派人缢杀晋安帝，改立其弟晋恭帝。420年恭帝禅位，刘裕即位为宋武帝，国号宋，史称刘宋，以区别于后来960年建立的赵宋。他试图压制门阀大族，更多任用寒门出身的人。刘裕于422年去世，其子宋文帝在位期间的“元嘉之治”是一段相对繁荣的时期。
liu-song.why: It began the Southern Dynasties, and from then on the south's rulers were usually generals rather than aristocrats.
liu-song.why_zh: 刘宋开启了南朝时代，此后南方的统治者多是将领出身，而非门阀贵族。

story: Northern Wei, under its energetic emperor Taiwu, spent the 420s and 430s conquering the remaining Sixteen Kingdoms. It took the Xiongnu state of Xia and its fortress capital Tongwancheng in 427, and destroyed Northern Yan in the northeast in 436.

In 439 Taiwu marched across the desert to Guzang, capital of Northern Liang in the Gansu corridor. After a short siege its ruler Juqu Mujian surrendered. Northern Liang's capital was a center of Buddhist learning, and Wei moved tens of thousands of its people, including monks and craftsmen, to Pingcheng. For the first time since 316, all of northern China was under one dynasty, facing the Liu Song in the south.
story_zh: 北魏在雄才大略的太武帝领导下，于420至430年代逐一消灭残存的十六国政权：427年攻破匈奴夏国的都城统万城，436年灭东北的北燕。
439年，太武帝率军穿越沙漠，进攻河西走廊上北凉的都城姑臧。围城不久，北凉国主沮渠牧犍投降。姑臧是佛学重镇，北魏把当地数万户百姓连同僧人和工匠迁往平城。这是316年以来北方首次统一于一个王朝，与南方的刘宋形成对峙。
wei-unifies-north.why: It ended the Sixteen Kingdoms and began the North-South division that lasted until 589.
wei-unifies-north.why_zh: 这结束了十六国时代，开启了延续到589年的南北朝对峙。

story: After Emperor Taiwu's persecution of Buddhism ended with his death in 452, his successors restored the faith. Around 460 the monk Tanyao, head of the Buddhist clergy, asked Emperor Wencheng to carve five great caves in the sandstone cliffs at Wuzhou Mountain, west of Pingcheng.

Each of the five "Tanyao caves" holds a colossal Buddha, the largest about 17 meters high, and they are said to represent the five founding emperors of Northern Wei, presented as Buddhas. Work went on for decades, with more than 250 caves and over 50,000 statues. The early carvings show strong influence from Gandhara and Central Asia, while later ones grow more Chinese in style.
story_zh: 太武帝灭佛的行动在他452年去世后结束，继任的皇帝重新扶持佛教。约460年，主管全国僧务的沙门统昙曜请求文成帝在平城以西武州山的砂岩崖壁上开凿五座大窟。
这五座“昙曜五窟”中各有一尊巨佛，最高的约17米，据说象征北魏开国以来的五位皇帝。此后开凿持续了几十年，共形成250多个洞窟、五万多尊造像。早期造像明显带有犍陀罗和中亚风格，后期则越来越具有中国特色。
yungang.why: Yungang is one of the three great Buddhist cave sites in China and shows how Buddhist art was adapted to Chinese taste.
yungang.why_zh: 云冈石窟是中国三大石窟之一，展现了佛教艺术逐渐中国化的过程。

story: The later Liu Song emperors were often violent and unstable, and the court was torn by family killings. The general Xiao Daocheng gained power by defeating rebel princes. In 477 the teenage Emperor Houfei, who liked to roam the streets killing people, was murdered by his own attendants, and Xiao Daocheng put a younger prince on the throne.

Two years later, in 479, that prince abdicated, and Xiao Daocheng became Emperor Gao of a new dynasty, Qi, known as Southern Qi. The Liu Song royal family was largely wiped out. The new dynasty was short-lived: it lasted only 23 years, and its later rulers also killed many of their own relatives.
story_zh: 刘宋后期的皇帝大多残暴昏乱，宗室之间相互残杀。将领萧道成因平定宗王叛乱而掌握大权。477年，喜欢在街上随意杀人的少年皇帝后废帝被左右侍从杀死，萧道成另立一位年幼的皇子。
两年后的479年，这位小皇帝禅位，萧道成即位为齐高帝，国号齐，史称南齐。刘宋皇族几乎被诛杀殆尽。南齐国祚很短，只有二十三年，后来的皇帝同样大肆屠戮宗室。
southern-qi.why: It showed the pattern of the Southern Dynasties: generals seizing the throne and royal families destroying themselves.
southern-qi.why_zh: 南齐的建立体现了南朝的典型模式：武将夺取帝位，皇族自相残杀。

story: Emperor Xiaowen came to the throne as a child in 471 and was raised by the powerful Empress Dowager Feng, who carried out major reforms. After her death in 490 he pushed further. He wanted his Xianbei state to become a Chinese-style empire.

In 493 he led an army south, supposedly to attack the Southern Qi. When the rains made the march miserable, he offered his reluctant nobles a choice: continue the campaign, or settle at Luoyang. They chose Luoyang, and the capital was moved there in 494. He then banned Xianbei dress at court and the Xianbei language for officials under thirty, changed the royal surname Tuoba to Yuan, and encouraged marriage between Xianbei and Chinese elite families.
story_zh: 孝文帝于471年幼年即位，由大权在握的冯太后抚养，冯太后主持了多项重大改革。490年太后去世后，孝文帝进一步推进改革，希望把鲜卑政权变成汉式帝国。
493年，他率大军南下，名义上是讨伐南齐。秋雨连绵，行军艰苦，他给不愿南迁的贵族两个选择：要么继续南征，要么定都洛阳。众人选择了后者，494年正式迁都洛阳。此后他禁止朝中穿鲜卑服装，三十岁以下的官员不许说鲜卑语，把皇族姓氏拓跋改为元，并鼓励鲜卑贵族与汉人士族通婚。
xiaowen.why: The reforms sped the blending of Xianbei and Chinese culture, but they also alienated the frontier soldiers left behind in the north.
xiaowen.why_zh: 改革加速了鲜卑与汉文化的融合，却也使留在北方边镇的将士感到被冷落。

story: Xiao Yan was a distant relative of the Southern Qi royal family and a governor on the middle Yangtze. The Qi emperor Xiao Baojuan was notorious for cruelty and killed many officials, including Xiao Yan's elder brother.

In 501 Xiao Yan rose in revolt, marched down the Yangtze and took Jiankang, where Xiao Baojuan was killed by his own officers. In 502 Xiao Yan took the throne as Emperor Wu of Liang. He was a scholar, poet and devout Buddhist who ate no meat and banned animal sacrifice. His court became a center of literature and learning, and Jiankang was said to have nearly 500 temples. But his indulgence of royal relatives and neglect of the army left Liang weak.
story_zh: 萧衍是南齐皇室的远亲，任长江中游的地方长官。南齐皇帝萧宝卷以残暴闻名，杀害了许多大臣，其中包括萧衍的哥哥。
501年，萧衍起兵，顺江而下攻占建康，萧宝卷被部下所杀。502年，萧衍即位为梁武帝。他是学者、诗人，也是虔诚的佛教徒，终身素食，还废除了宗庙祭祀用牲畜的做法。他的朝廷成为文学和学术的中心，建康据说有近五百座佛寺。但他纵容宗室，忽视军备，使梁朝日渐虚弱。
liang-founded.why: Liang marked the cultural peak of the Southern Dynasties, but its weaknesses led to the disaster of Hou Jing's revolt.
liang-founded.why_zh: 梁朝是南朝文化的巅峰，但它的种种弊端最终酿成了侯景之乱。

story: In the early 500s Northern Wei pushed south across the Huai River. In 506 a huge Wei army under Prince Yuan Ying besieged Zhongli, a fortress on the Huai, held by the Liang officer Chang Jingxiang with only about 3,000 men. The Wei built a long floating bridge across the river to supply their troops.

Zhongli held out through the winter. In 507 Emperor Wu of Liang sent the generals Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong to relieve it. Wei Rui built a fortified camp in a single night close to the enemy. When spring floods raised the Huai, the Liang navy sent fire ships against the Wei bridge and burned it. The Wei army broke, and the histories say over 100,000 men were killed or drowned.
story_zh: 六世纪初，北魏越过淮河南进。506年，北魏中山王元英率大军围攻淮河边的钟离城，梁朝守将昌义之手下只有约三千人。魏军在淮河上架起长长的浮桥运送粮草。
钟离坚守了整个冬天。507年，梁武帝派韦睿、曹景宗率军救援。韦睿一夜之间在魏军附近筑起营垒。春季淮河水涨，梁军用火船焚烧魏军浮桥，魏军全线崩溃，史载被杀和淹死的有十余万人。
zhongli.why: It halted Northern Wei's push into the south and kept the Huai River as the frontier for years.
zhongli.why_zh: 此战阻止了北魏南侵，使淮河一线在此后多年保持稳定。

story: Northern Wei had built six garrisons along its northern frontier to guard against the Rouran. Their soldiers were mostly Xianbei and other tribesmen, once proud elite troops. After the capital moved to Luoyang in 494, they were looked down on, poorly supplied and denied promotion.

A famine hit the frontier, and in 523–524 the garrison soldiers rose, led at first by Poliuhan Baling at Woye. The revolt spread across the north. The court called in Rouran help and settled hundreds of thousands of surrendered rebels in Hebei, where new revolts broke out. Out of this chaos rose the warlord Erzhu Rong and, after him, Gao Huan and Yuwen Tai, all men from the garrisons.
story_zh: 北魏在北部边境设立六个军镇，防御柔然。镇兵多为鲜卑等族人，曾是地位很高的精锐部队。494年迁都洛阳后，他们受到轻视，补给不足，升迁无望。
边境发生饥荒，523至524年间，镇兵在沃野镇破六韩拔陵的带领下起兵，起义迅速蔓延到整个北方。朝廷借助柔然兵力镇压，又把二十多万降众安置在河北，结果引发新的叛乱。在这场混乱中崛起了军阀尔朱荣，以及后来的高欢和宇文泰，他们都出身于六镇。
six-garrisons.why: The revolt destroyed Northern Wei's order and produced the generals who founded Eastern Wei, Western Wei, and in time the Sui and Tang ruling elites.
six-garrisons.why_zh: 这场起义摧毁了北魏的统治秩序，也造就了建立东魏、西魏的将领，乃至后来隋唐的统治集团。

story: After the Heyin massacre of 528, Erzhu Rong controlled Northern Wei, but he was killed by the emperor in 530. Gao Huan, a former Erzhu officer, then defeated the Erzhu clan and took control of the court at Luoyang. He put Emperor Xiaowu on the throne.

The emperor resented Gao Huan and in 534 fled west to Chang'an, to the general Yuwen Tai. Gao Huan set up another prince, Emperor Xiaojing, and moved the capital from Luoyang to Ye. Late in 534 Yuwen Tai poisoned Emperor Xiaowu and put another prince on the throne in Chang'an. Two Wei states now existed: Eastern Wei, ruled in practice by Gao Huan, and Western Wei, ruled by Yuwen Tai.
story_zh: 528年河阴之变后，尔朱荣控制了北魏，530年被皇帝刺杀。尔朱荣的旧部高欢随后击败尔朱氏，掌握洛阳朝廷，扶立孝武帝。
孝武帝不甘受制于高欢，534年西奔长安，投靠关中大将宇文泰。高欢另立孝静帝，把都城从洛阳迁到邺城。同年年底，宇文泰毒死孝武帝，在长安另立新君。从此北魏一分为二：高欢实际掌控的东魏和宇文泰掌控的西魏。
wei-splits.why: The split set up the long rivalry of east and west in the north, which the western side eventually won.
wei-splits.why_zh: 北魏分裂开启了北方东西对峙的长期局面，最终西方一方取得了胜利。

people.name: Gao Huan
people.role: Ruler of Eastern Wei in practice

people.name: Yuwen Tai
people.role: Ruler of Western Wei in practice

story: Jiaozhou, the Red River delta of today's Vietnam, had been ruled by Chinese dynasties for centuries. In the 540s the Liang governor Xiao Zi was unpopular for harsh rule. Lý Bí, a local leader of mixed Chinese and Vietnamese descent who had served as a minor official, rose against him in 541 and drove him out.

Lý Bí defeated Liang armies sent to retake the region and in 544 declared himself emperor of the kingdom of Van Xuan, meaning "ten thousand springs." In 545 Liang sent the general Chen Baxian, the future founder of the Chen dynasty, who defeated Lý Bí. He fled into the mountains and died in 548. His followers, notably Triệu Quang Phục, kept resisting for years.
story_zh: 交州（今越南红河三角洲）已被中原王朝统治了几百年。540年代，梁朝交州刺史萧谘施政苛暴，不得人心。李贲是有汉越血统的当地豪强，曾做过小官，541年起兵把萧谘赶走。
李贲击败梁朝派来的军队，544年自称皇帝，国号万春。545年，梁朝派后来建立陈朝的陈霸先南征，击败李贲。李贲逃入山区，548年去世。他的部下赵光复等人此后多年继续抵抗。
ly-bi.why: In Vietnam, Van Xuan is remembered as an early independent state and a forerunner of later independence from China.
ly-bi.why_zh: 在越南，万春国被视为早期的独立政权，是后来脱离中国独立的先声。

story: Hou Jing was a general of Eastern Wei who rebelled after Gao Huan's death in 547 and offered his lands to Liang. Emperor Wu of Liang accepted, against advice. When Liang then sought peace with Eastern Wei, Hou feared he would be handed back.

In 548 he crossed the Yangtze with fewer than ten thousand men, helped by a Liang prince who opened the way. He besieged the palace city of Jiankang for four months while Liang princes with large armies nearby did nothing. In 549 the palace fell, and the 85-year-old Emperor Wu died, reportedly of hunger and neglect. Hou Jing ravaged the south and declared himself emperor in 551, but he was defeated by Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian and killed in 552.
story_zh: 侯景原是东魏将领，547年高欢死后叛魏，表示愿以所辖之地归附梁朝。梁武帝不顾劝阻接纳了他。后来梁朝与东魏议和，侯景担心自己被交还东魏。
548年，侯景在梁朝宗室萧正德的接应下，率不到一万人渡过长江，围攻建康台城四个多月。附近拥有重兵的梁朝诸王却按兵不动。549年台城陷落，八十五岁的梁武帝据说在冷落中饥饿而死。侯景在江南烧杀抢掠，551年称帝，次年被王僧辩、陈霸先击败，死于逃亡途中。
hou-jing.why: The revolt ruined the rich Jiankang region and destroyed the Liang, leaving the south too weak to resist the north.
hou-jing.why_zh: 侯景之乱使富庶的建康地区遭到毁灭性破坏，梁朝因此崩溃，南方从此无力与北方抗衡。

story: Gao Huan had ruled Eastern Wei as its chief minister, leaving a puppet emperor on the throne. After he died in 547, his eldest son Gao Cheng took over, but he was murdered by a cook in 549.

Gao Huan's second son, Gao Yang, took control. In 550 he forced Emperor Xiaojing to abdicate and became emperor of a new dynasty, Qi, called Northern Qi, with its capital at Ye. Northern Qi had the richest lands in the north and a strong army. But Gao Yang became known for drunken cruelty, and the Gao family's later rulers were often unstable and violent. Court struggles between Xianbei generals and Chinese officials weakened the state.
story_zh: 高欢生前以丞相身份主持东魏朝政，保留傀儡皇帝。547年他去世后，长子高澄继承权位，549年却被厨子刺杀。
高欢次子高洋接掌大权，550年逼东魏孝静帝禅位，建立齐朝，史称北齐，定都邺城。北齐据有北方最富庶的地区，军力也很强。但高洋后来以酗酒残暴闻名，高氏后来的几位君主也多荒淫暴虐。鲜卑勋贵与汉人士族之间的争斗进一步削弱了国力。
northern-qi.why: Northern Qi was richer than its western rival, yet bad rule let Northern Zhou conquer it in 577.
northern-qi.why_zh: 北齐虽比西边的对手富强，却因政治腐败在577年被北周所灭。

story: After Hou Jing's defeat, Xiao Yi, a son of Emperor Wu of Liang, took the throne as Emperor Yuan. He chose to stay at his base in Jiangling rather than return to ruined Jiankang. He was a scholar with a great library but a poor strategist, and he had already fought several of his own brothers and nephews.

In 554, after Emperor Yuan sent an insulting letter to Western Wei, Yuwen Tai sent an army of 50,000 under Yu Jin. Jiangling fell within weeks. Before surrendering, Emperor Yuan set fire to his library, saying that ten thousand scrolls of learning had not saved him. He was executed. Western Wei carried tens of thousands of people north as slaves and set up a nephew, Xiao Cha, as a puppet ruler of Western Liang.
story_zh: 侯景败亡后，梁武帝之子萧绎即位，是为梁元帝。他不愿回到残破的建康，而是留在自己的根据地江陵。他学问渊博，藏书丰富，却不善谋略，此前还与自己的兄弟和侄子反复交战。
554年，梁元帝致信西魏言辞不逊，宇文泰派于谨率五万大军南下。几周之内江陵城破。投降前，梁元帝下令焚毁藏书，说“读书万卷，犹有今日”。他随后被杀。西魏把江陵数万百姓掳往北方为奴，并扶立萧詧为西梁傀儡皇帝。
jiangling-falls.why: The burning of the library was one of the great cultural losses in Chinese history, and the defeat left the south even weaker.
jiangling-falls.why_zh: 焚书是中国历史上重大的文化浩劫之一，江陵陷落也使南方更加衰弱。

story: Chen Baxian rose from a humble family in Wuxing to become a Liang general. He fought in the far south against Lý Bí and in 551–552 joined Wang Sengbian to defeat Hou Jing.

After Jiangling fell in 554, Wang Sengbian agreed to accept a Liang prince backed by Northern Qi as emperor. Chen Baxian opposed this, and in 555 he made a surprise attack and killed Wang. He then beat off Northern Qi armies that reached the outskirts of Jiankang. In 557 he forced the last Liang emperor to abdicate and became Emperor Wu of Chen. The new state held only the land south of the Yangtze and east of the Three Gorges, and it was poorer than Liang had been.
story_zh: 陈霸先出身吴兴寒门，后来成为梁朝将领。他曾南征交州的李贲，551至552年又与王僧辩一同平定侯景。
554年江陵陷落后，王僧辩同意接受北齐扶持的梁朝宗室为帝。陈霸先表示反对，555年突袭杀死王僧辩，随后又击退了一路打到建康城郊的北齐军队。557年，他逼梁朝末帝禅位，即位为陈武帝。陈朝只据有长江以南、三峡以东的地区，国力远不如梁朝。
chen-founded.why: Chen was the last of the Southern Dynasties and fell to Sui in 589.
chen-founded.why_zh: 陈朝是南朝的最后一个王朝，589年被隋朝所灭。

story: Yuwen Tai ruled Western Wei for over twenty years without taking the throne. He built a strong state in the Wei River valley, borrowing ideas from the ancient Zhou rituals and creating a new militia army. He died in 556 and left his nephew Yuwen Hu as guardian of his young sons.

Early in 557 Yuwen Hu had the last Western Wei emperor abdicate to Yuwen Tai's son Yuwen Jue, who took the old title Heavenly King of Zhou. The state is called Northern Zhou. Yuwen Hu held real power and killed Yuwen Jue later the same year, and also killed the next ruler. Only in 572 did Emperor Wu, a third son, kill Yuwen Hu and rule in his own right.
story_zh: 宇文泰执掌西魏二十多年，始终没有称帝。他在关中建立了强大的政权，仿照《周礼》改革官制，并创立了新的府兵制度。556年他去世，把年幼的儿子们托付给侄子宇文护。
557年初，宇文护逼西魏末帝禅位给宇文泰之子宇文觉，宇文觉称周天王，史称北周。实权掌握在宇文护手中，他当年便杀了宇文觉，后来又杀了下一位君主。直到572年，宇文泰的另一个儿子北周武帝才诛杀宇文护，亲掌朝政。
northern-zhou.why: Northern Zhou conquered the north, and its leading families went on to found both the Sui and the Tang.
northern-zhou.why_zh: 北周后来统一北方，其统治集团中的家族又先后建立了隋朝和唐朝。

story: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou took full power in 572. He strengthened the army, banned Buddhism to raise money and men, and made an alliance with the Turks. Northern Qi, under the extravagant Gao Wei, had executed its best general, Hulü Guang, in 572.

In 576 Emperor Wu attacked Pingyang in Shanxi and then routed the Qi army that came to relieve it. He advanced to Jinyang, Qi's second capital, and took it after fierce street fighting. Early in 577 he captured Ye. Gao Wei had abdicated to his young son and fled, but he was caught and later killed. Northern Qi's lands and some twenty million people passed to Northern Zhou.
story_zh: 北周武帝572年亲政后，整顿军队，禁断佛教以充实财力兵源，并与突厥结盟。北齐后主高纬奢侈无度，572年还冤杀了最得力的大将斛律光。
576年，周武帝进攻山西的平阳，随后击溃前来救援的齐军，又进兵北齐的陪都晋阳，经过激烈巷战攻克该城。577年初，北周军攻下邺城。高纬已把皇位传给年幼的儿子后出逃，结果被俘，后来遇害。北齐的疆土和两千万人口全部归入北周。
zhou-conquers-qi.why: It reunited northern China and gave Northern Zhou, and soon the Sui, the strength to conquer the south.
zhou-conquers-qi.why_zh: 北方由此重归统一，北周以及随后的隋朝也因此具备了征服南方的实力。

story: Fan Ye was an official of the Liu Song court from a distinguished family. After he offended the emperor's brother, he was demoted to a provincial post in 432. There he began writing a history of the Eastern Han, drawing on several earlier histories that have since been lost.

He completed the main annals and biographies, and his work became the standard Book of the Later Han. It added new types of chapters, such as biographies of notable women and of hermits. In 445 he was accused of joining a plot to put a prince on the throne, and he was executed with his sons. The treatises were left unfinished; later editions added treatises written by Sima Biao of the Jin.
story_zh: 范晔出身名门，在刘宋朝中做官。432年他得罪了皇帝的弟弟，被贬到地方任职。在那里他开始撰写东汉史，参考了多种前人所著、后来已经失传的史书。
他写成了帝纪和列传，成为后世公认的正史《后汉书》。书中新设了列女传、逸民传等类目。445年，范晔被指控参与拥立宗王的谋反案，与儿子一同被处死。书中的“志”没有完成，后人把晋代司马彪所作的志补入其中。
hou-han-shu.why: It is one of the Four Histories, the core of the official Chinese dynastic histories, and the main source on the Eastern Han.
hou-han-shu.why_zh: 《后汉书》是“前四史”之一，也是研究东汉历史最主要的资料。

story: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei was influenced by his Chinese minister Cui Hao and the Daoist master Kou Qianzhi, who saw Buddhism as a foreign faith. Many young men also became monks to avoid taxes and military service.

In 445 a revolt broke out in the Chang'an region. While putting it down in 446, the emperor found weapons, wine and stores in a Chang'an temple and suspected the monks of supporting the rebels. He ordered monks in Chang'an executed and later extended the order across the empire: temples, scriptures and images were to be destroyed. The crown prince delayed the edict, allowing many monks to flee and texts to be hidden. The persecution ended after Taiwu's death in 452.
story_zh: 北魏太武帝受汉人大臣崔浩和道士寇谦之的影响，认为佛教是外来宗教。当时还有许多青年出家为僧，以逃避赋役。
445年，关中爆发叛乱。446年太武帝率军镇压时，在长安一座寺院里发现了兵器、酒和大量财物，怀疑僧人与叛军勾结。他下令诛杀长安僧人，随后推广到全国：焚毁寺庙、经书和佛像。太子拖延发布诏令，使许多僧人得以逃走，经卷也被藏匿起来。452年太武帝死后，禁佛随之结束。
taiwu-persecution.why: It was the first of the "Three Wu and One Zong" persecutions of Buddhism in Chinese history.
taiwu-persecution.why_zh: 这是中国历史上“三武一宗”灭佛事件中的第一次。

story: Emperor Wen of Liu Song had long dreamed of retaking the lands south of the Yellow River. In 450, against the advice of experienced generals, he launched a large northern campaign. His army under Wang Xuanmo besieged Huatai on the Yellow River but failed to take it and fled when Wei cavalry arrived.

Emperor Taiwu of Wei then counterattacked. His army swept across the Huai region, killing and burning, and late in 450 reached Guabu on the north bank of the Yangtze, opposite Jiankang. The southern capital was in panic. Wei did not try to cross, and early in 451 it withdrew, carrying off many captives. On the way back it failed to take the fortress of Xuyi.
story_zh: 宋文帝一直想收复黄河以南的土地。450年，他不顾宿将劝阻，大举北伐。王玄谟率军围攻黄河边的滑台，久攻不下，北魏骑兵一到便溃逃。
北魏太武帝随即反击，大军横扫江淮之间，烧杀掳掠，450年底直抵建康对岸长江北岸的瓜步，建康城中一片惊恐。北魏没有渡江，451年初撤军，掳走大批百姓，回师途中围攻盱眙也没能攻下。
yuanjia-campaign.why: It ruined the prosperous Yuanjia era, and the south never again seriously threatened the north.
yuanjia-campaign.why_zh: 元嘉北伐的失败断送了“元嘉之治”的繁荣，此后南方再也无力对北方构成严重威胁。

story: Zu Chongzhi came from a family of astronomers and officials in Liu Song. In 462 he presented a new calendar, the Daming calendar. It used a more accurate value for the length of the year and was the first Chinese calendar to take account of the precession of the equinoxes. Court conservatives opposed it, and it was adopted only in 510, after his death.

He also worked on pi, extending Liu Hui's polygon method, and showed that it lay between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927. He gave 355/113 as a close fraction, the best rational approximation with a small denominator; this precision was not matched elsewhere for nearly a thousand years. He also designed a south-pointing chariot and improved water mills.
story_zh: 祖冲之出身刘宋的天文官员世家。462年，他献上新编的《大明历》。这部历法采用更精确的回归年长度，并首次在中国历法中考虑了岁差。朝中守旧派表示反对，直到他死后的510年才被采用。
他还在刘徽割圆术的基础上计算圆周率，证明它在3.1415926与3.1415927之间，并提出“密率”355/113，这是分母较小的分数中最精确的近似值。这一精度在世界上领先了近一千年。他还设计过指南车，改进了水碓磨。
zu-chongzhi.why: His value for pi was the most precise in the world for nearly a millennium, and he is one of China's best-known scientists.
zu-chongzhi.why_zh: 他求得的圆周率在近千年里保持世界领先，祖冲之也成为中国最著名的科学家之一。

story: Decades of war had left much of northern China's farmland abandoned, while powerful families controlled large estates and many peasants. The court of Northern Wei, then guided by Empress Dowager Feng, wanted to bring people back to the land and make them pay taxes directly to the state.

In 485 an edict, based on a proposal by the official Li Anshi, set out the equal-field system. Every adult man received a share of open fields to grow grain, and women received a smaller share. These fields returned to the state at the holder's death or old age. Households also received permanent plots for mulberry trees. In 486 a new village organization, the three-elders system, was set up to register households and collect taxes.
story_zh: 连年战乱使北方大片农田荒芜，豪强大族却占有大量土地和依附农民。当时由冯太后主政的北魏朝廷，希望让百姓重新回到土地上，直接向国家纳税。
485年，朝廷采纳李安世的建议，颁布均田令：成年男子按规定授给露田种植粮食，妇女也授给较少的份额，受田者年老或死亡后须归还国家；此外每户还授给可以世代传承的桑田。486年又推行三长制，设邻长、里长、党长，负责登记户口、征收赋税。
equal-field.why: The equal-field system lasted, with changes, through the Sui and into the mid-Tang, and it was copied in Japan.
equal-field.why_zh: 均田制经过调整，一直沿用到隋朝和唐朝中期，日本也曾仿效实行。

story: Liu Xie came from a poor family and lived for over ten years in a Buddhist monastery at Dinglin Temple near Jiankang, where he helped catalog scriptures. Around the turn of the sixth century, at the end of the Southern Qi, he wrote The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons.

The book has fifty chapters written in elegant parallel prose. It traces the origins of literature to the Confucian classics, surveys more than thirty genres from poetry to official documents, and discusses style, structure, imagination and the writer's character. Liu Xie is said to have waited by the roadside to show it to the famous writer Shen Yue, who praised it. Liu later served Liang and ended life as a monk.
story_zh: 刘勰家境贫寒，曾在建康附近的定林寺依附僧人生活十余年，协助整理佛经。大约在南齐末年，即六世纪之初，他写成了《文心雕龙》。
全书五十篇，用典雅的骈文写成。它把文学的源头追溯到儒家经典，论述了从诗歌到公文等三十多种文体，还探讨了风格、结构、想象力和作家修养等问题。据说刘勰在路边等候名士沈约，把书呈给他看，沈约大为赞赏。刘勰后来在梁朝做官，晚年出家为僧。
wenxin-diaolong.why: It is the greatest work of literary theory in classical Chinese and still shapes how Chinese literature is studied.
wenxin-diaolong.why_zh: 《文心雕龙》是中国古代最重要的文学理论著作，至今仍影响着中国文学研究。

story: In 528 Empress Dowager Hu, who ruled Northern Wei for her son Emperor Xiaoming, was suspected of poisoning him after he tried to escape her control. She placed an infant on the throne. Erzhu Rong, a powerful chief whose cavalry had been fighting the frontier rebels, used this as an excuse to march on Luoyang.

He set up Yuan Ziyou as Emperor Xiaozhuang and entered the capital without a fight. He had the Empress Dowager and the infant emperor thrown into the Yellow River. Then he summoned the court officials to Heyin, near the river, accused them of misrule, and had his cavalry kill them: the histories give the dead as over two thousand, including many princes.
story_zh: 528年，临朝听政的胡太后被怀疑毒死了想摆脱她控制的亲生儿子孝明帝，随后立一个婴儿为帝。手握重兵、一直在镇压边镇叛乱的契胡首领尔朱荣以此为借口进军洛阳。
他拥立元子攸为孝庄帝，兵不血刃进入京城，把胡太后和幼帝投入黄河淹死。接着他召集文武百官到黄河边的河阴，指责他们祸国殃民，纵兵屠杀，史载死者两千余人，其中包括许多宗室亲王。
heyin.why: It wiped out much of the Northern Wei elite and left the dynasty in the hands of warlords until its split in 534.
heyin.why_zh: 河阴之变几乎清除了北魏的统治精英，此后直到534年分裂，北魏一直由军阀操纵。

people.name: Emperor Xiaozhuang
people.role: Emperor set up by Erzhu Rong

story: Xiao Tong was the eldest son of Emperor Wu of Liang and crown prince for almost thirty years. He was a devoted scholar who gathered a library of some 30,000 scrolls and a circle of writers at his court. He died young in 531, before he could take the throne, and was given the posthumous title Prince Zhaoming.

With his scholars he compiled the Wen Xuan, an anthology of about 760 poems, rhapsodies, letters, essays and other pieces from the late Zhou to the Liang, arranged by genre. He chose works for their artistry rather than their moral or historical content, and left out philosophy and history. The Tang scholar Li Shan later wrote a full commentary on it, which is still used.
story_zh: 萧统是梁武帝的长子，做了近三十年太子。他酷爱读书，藏书近三万卷，身边聚集了一批文士。531年，萧统未及即位便英年早逝，谥号昭明，因此后人称他昭明太子。
他与文士们共同编成《文选》，收录从先秦到梁代的诗、赋、书信、论说等作品七百多篇，按文体分类编排。他选文注重文学性，而不看重道德或史料价值，经、史、子类著作一律不收。唐代李善为它作了详尽的注释，至今仍在使用。
wen-xuan.why: The Wen Xuan preserved many works that would otherwise be lost, and in the Tang it became essential study for the civil examinations.
wen-xuan.why_zh: 《文选》保存了许多原本可能失传的作品。到了唐代，它成为科举考生的必读书，有“《文选》烂，秀才半”之说。

story: Jia Sixie served as governor of Gaoyang commandery in Shandong under the late Northern Wei. Little else is known about his life. He collected knowledge from older books, from farmers and from his own experience, and wrote the Qimin Yaoshu, "Essential Techniques for the Welfare of the People," around 544.

Its ten chapters cover plowing and soil care, the growing of grains, vegetables and fruit trees, raising horses, cattle, sheep and fish, and food processing. It explains crop rotation, seed selection and green manure. It also gives detailed methods for making wine, vinegar, soy sauce and other fermented foods, and many recipes for cooking. Its practical advice was copied by farm writers for centuries.
story_zh: 贾思勰在北魏末年任高阳郡太守，其余生平几乎没有记载。他收集古书中的知识，向农民请教，又结合自己的经验，大约在544年写成《齐民要术》，意思是“百姓谋生的重要方法”。
全书十卷，内容包括耕作与土壤管理，粮食、蔬菜和果树的种植，马、牛、羊和鱼的饲养，以及食品加工。书中介绍了轮作、选种和绿肥等技术，还详细记载了酿酒、制醋、做酱等发酵方法和大量烹饪菜谱。此后历代农书都大量引用它的内容。
qimin-yaoshu.why: It is the oldest complete agricultural book in China and a key source for early farming and food history.
qimin-yaoshu.why_zh: 《齐民要术》是中国现存最早、最完整的农书，也是研究古代农业和饮食史的重要资料。

story: Western Wei was smaller and poorer than its eastern rival. After heavy losses at Mangshan in 543, Yuwen Tai began recruiting local Han Chinese strongmen and their followers into the army alongside the Xianbei troops.

By about 550 the army had been organized into 24 units under twelve generals, who in turn were led by six of the Eight Pillars of State, the top commanders. Soldier families were registered separately, freed from ordinary taxes and labor, and trained when not farming. The Eight Pillars and the twelve generals became a closely linked elite, intermarrying across Xianbei and Han lines. The families of Yang Jian and Li Yuan, founders of Sui and Tang, came from this group.
story_zh: 西魏比东魏国小力弱。543年邙山之战损失惨重后，宇文泰开始招募关陇地区汉人豪强及其部曲入伍，与鲜卑士兵一同编组。
到550年前后，军队编为二十四军，由十二大将军统领，其上又有八柱国中的六人统辖。府兵家庭单独登记户籍，免除普通的赋税徭役，农闲时训练。八柱国和十二大将军结成关系紧密的统治集团，鲜卑与汉人家族相互通婚。隋朝的杨坚、唐朝的李渊，家族都出自这一集团。
fubing.why: The fubing system became the core of the Sui and early Tang armies, and its leaders formed the elite that ruled China for two centuries.
fubing.why_zh: 府兵制成为隋朝和唐初军队的核心，其统帅家族形成了此后统治中国两百年的关陇集团。

people.name: Yuwen Tai
people.role: Ruler of Western Wei in practice

story: The Turks were a people of ironworkers in the Altai Mountains who served the Rouran Khaganate, which then ruled the Mongolian steppe. Their leader Bumin had first sent envoys to Western Wei in 545.

When the Rouran khan refused him a royal bride and called him a slave of smiths, Bumin married a Western Wei princess instead. In 552 he defeated the Rouran, whose khan killed himself, and Bumin took the title Illig Qaghan. Within a few decades the Turks controlled the steppe from Manchuria to the Black Sea. Northern Zhou and Northern Qi competed for their favor with gifts of silk; the Turkish ruler Taspar is said to have joked that as long as his two sons in the south were dutiful, he need not worry.
story_zh: 突厥原是居住在阿尔泰山一带、以冶铁为业的部落，臣属于当时统治蒙古高原的柔然汗国。他们的首领土门在545年首次遣使西魏。
柔然可汗拒绝把公主嫁给土门，还骂他是“锻奴”。土门转而迎娶了西魏公主。552年，他大败柔然，柔然可汗自杀，土门自称伊利可汗。此后几十年间，突厥控制了从东北到黑海的广阔草原。北周和北齐争相用丝绸讨好突厥，突厥他钵可汗曾说：“但使我在南两个儿孝顺，何忧无物邪！”
turkic-khaganate.why: The Turks became the great steppe power facing China, a key factor in Sui and Tang foreign policy.
turkic-khaganate.why_zh: 突厥成为与中原对峙的草原强国，是隋唐对外关系中的关键因素。

story: By the 570s Buddhist monasteries in Northern Zhou held huge amounts of land and wealth, and great numbers of people had become monks and nuns, outside the tax and army rolls. Emperor Wu, preparing for war with Northern Qi, wanted those resources for the state. He held several court debates on the ranking of Confucianism, Daoism and Buddhism.

In 574 he issued an edict banning both Buddhism and Daoism. Scriptures and images were destroyed, temples were given to princes and officials, and monks and nuns, said to number around two million, were returned to lay life. When Northern Zhou conquered Northern Qi in 577, the ban was extended there. The persecution ended after his death in 578, and Buddhism revived quickly under Sui.
story_zh: 到了570年代，北周的佛寺占有大量土地和财富，大批人口出家为僧尼，脱离了国家的赋役和兵籍。正在准备与北齐开战的周武帝想把这些资源收归国家。他多次召集群臣辩论儒、道、佛三教的高下。
574年，他下诏同时禁断佛、道二教，销毁经像，把寺观赐给王公大臣，令僧尼道士还俗，据说还俗者达二百万人左右。577年灭北齐后，禁令又推行到北齐故地。578年周武帝去世后，禁令解除，佛教在隋朝迅速复兴。
zhou-bans-buddhism.why: It was the second of the four great persecutions of Buddhism, and it helped fund the conquest that reunited the north.
zhou-bans-buddhism.why_zh: 这是“三武一宗”灭佛中的第二次，也为北周统一北方提供了财力和兵源。

story: Cui Hao came from a leading Han Chinese family of Qinghe and served three Northern Wei emperors as an adviser on war and policy. He backed Emperor Taiwu's persecution of Buddhism and was put in charge of compiling the official state history.

With his colleagues he wrote a frank account of the early Tuoba rulers, including their steppe customs, which the Xianbei nobles considered shameful. Worse, the text was carved on stone tablets set up beside a main road for all to read. In 450 Emperor Taiwu, angered, ordered Cui Hao executed, and his whole clan was wiped out along with related families such as the Lu and Liu. Many of his colleagues on the project died with him.
story_zh: 崔浩出身清河崔氏，是北方汉人头等士族，先后辅佐北魏三代皇帝，参与军国大计。他支持太武帝禁佛，并受命主持编修国史。
他和同僚如实记录了拓跋先世的事迹，包括鲜卑人在草原时期的习俗，令鲜卑贵族深感耻辱。更严重的是，这部国史被刻在石碑上，立在大路旁供人观看。450年，太武帝大怒，下令处死崔浩，清河崔氏以及与其联姻的卢氏、柳氏等家族也一并被诛灭，许多参与修史的同僚也受牵连被杀。
cui-hao.why: It showed the tension between Xianbei rulers and Han Chinese elites that later reformers like Emperor Xiaowen tried to resolve.
cui-hao.why_zh: 这一事件暴露了鲜卑统治者与汉人士族之间的矛盾，后来孝文帝的改革正是试图化解这种矛盾。

story: The Water Classic was a short, older text listing 137 rivers of China. Li Daoyuan, a Northern Wei official known as a strict and fearless administrator, traveled widely on government service and read hundreds of earlier books.

In the early sixth century he wrote a commentary forty times longer than the original. It describes about 1,250 rivers and streams, following each from source to mouth, and records the cities, canals, bridges, tombs, temples, battles and local legends along the way. His descriptions of scenery, such as the Three Gorges of the Yangtze, are admired as literature. In 527 he was sent to deal with a rebellious governor and was killed.
story_zh: 《水经》是一部较早成书、篇幅简短的地理书，记载了137条河流。北魏官员郦道元以执法严峻、不畏权贵著称，他因公务走遍各地，又阅读了数百种前人著作。
六世纪初，他为《水经》作注，篇幅是原书的四十倍。书中记述了约1250条大小河流，从源头写到入海口，沿途的城邑、渠道、桥梁、陵墓、寺庙、古战场和民间传说都一一记录。他描写长江三峡等景色的文字，也被视为优美的散文。527年，他奉命处理一位谋反的刺史，途中遇害。
shuijingzhu.why: It is China's greatest early work of geography and preserves much information from books now lost.
shuijingzhu.why_zh: 《水经注》是中国古代最重要的地理著作，保存了大量已失传古书中的资料。

story: Emperor Wu of Liang was a devout Buddhist who lectured on sutras, wrote rules for monks and gave vast sums to monasteries. In 527 he built Tongtai Temple across from the palace in Jiankang.

That year he went to the temple and formally gave himself to it as a servant of the Buddha. After a few days he returned to the palace. In 529 he did it again, and this time the court ministers paid the temple a ransom of a hundred million cash to "buy back" their emperor. He repeated the act in 546 and 547, each time costing the state a huge sum. Critics then and later saw this as a sign of a ruler neglecting the state.
story_zh: 梁武帝笃信佛教，亲自讲经，制定僧人戒规，向寺院大量布施。527年，他在建康宫城对面修建了同泰寺。
这一年，他到同泰寺舍身为“寺奴”，几天后才回宫。529年他再次舍身，这一次群臣向寺院捐钱一亿，把皇帝“赎”了回来。546年和547年他又两次舍身，每次都耗费国家巨资。当时和后世的批评者都认为，这反映了一位君主荒废国政。
tongtai-temple.why: It became the best-known symbol of Buddhist influence at the southern court, and of the neglect that led to Liang's fall.
tongtai-temple.why_zh: 舍身同泰寺成为南朝佛教兴盛最著名的象征，也被视为导致梁朝衰亡的荒政之举。

story: In 528 Yuan Hao, a Northern Wei prince, fled to Liang after Erzhu Rong's massacre at Heyin. Emperor Wu of Liang made him King of Wei and sent the officer Chen Qingzhi, with only about 7,000 men, to escort him home.

Chen Qingzhi, a scholarly man who could not ride well or shoot, proved a brilliant commander. Over a few months in 529 his troops, who wore white robes, are said to have won 47 battles and taken 32 cities, and they entered Luoyang. Yuan Hao took the throne there. But Erzhu Rong counterattacked with a much larger army, Yuan Hao was killed, and Chen's force was destroyed by a flood. Chen escaped dressed as a monk.
story_zh: 528年河阴之变后，北魏宗室元颢逃到梁朝。梁武帝封他为魏王，派陈庆之率七千人护送他北归。
陈庆之是文人出身，不善骑射，却极有将才。529年的几个月间，他率领身穿白袍的部队据说打了四十七仗，攻下三十二座城，进入洛阳，元颢在洛阳称帝。但尔朱荣率大军反攻，元颢被杀，陈庆之的军队在撤退中遭山洪冲散，全军覆没。陈庆之剃发扮成僧人才逃回南方。
chen-qingzhi.why: It was one of the most remarkable campaigns of the era, though it achieved nothing lasting.
chen-qingzhi.why_zh: 这是南北朝最传奇的战役之一，但没有带来任何持久的成果。

story: In 537 Western Wei was suffering famine. Gao Huan of Eastern Wei led a large army, said to be 200,000 men, across the Yellow River to finish it off. Yuwen Tai could gather fewer than 10,000.

On the advice of his general Li Bi, Yuwen Tai set an ambush at Shayuan, an area of sand dunes and reeds near the Wei River. He hid his troops in the reeds and waited. Gao Huan's soldiers, seeing how few the enemy were, attacked in disorder. At a drum signal, the hidden troops burst out and cut the Eastern Wei army in two. Gao Huan fled, and some 70,000 men were captured, along with vast amounts of armor.
story_zh: 537年西魏发生饥荒。东魏高欢率领号称二十万的大军渡过黄河，想一举消灭西魏。宇文泰手下只有不到一万人。
宇文泰采纳部将李弼的建议，在渭河边沙丘芦苇丛生的沙苑设下埋伏，令士兵藏身芦苇中等待。东魏军见敌人兵少，争相冲锋，阵形大乱。伏兵听到鼓声一齐杀出，把东魏军截为两段。高欢败逃，东魏被俘约七万人，丢弃的铠甲兵器不计其数。
shayuan.why: The victory saved Western Wei and established Yuwen Tai's leadership, keeping the north divided for decades.
shayuan.why_zh: 沙苑之战挽救了西魏，巩固了宇文泰的地位，北方东西对峙的局面又延续了几十年。

people.role: Ruler of Western Wei in practice

story: Yubi was a Western Wei fortress in southern Shanxi guarding the route to the Wei valley. In 546 Gao Huan of Eastern Wei besieged it with a huge army. It was defended by Wei Xiaokuan with a small garrison.

For fifty days Gao Huan tried every method: he dammed the water supply, built earth mounds higher than the walls, dug tunnels and used rams. Wei Xiaokuan met each one, filling tunnels with fire and smoke and building higher towers. Some 70,000 attackers died. Gao Huan fell ill and lifted the siege. To raise morale he had his general Hulü Jin sing the Song of the Chile, and he joined in, weeping. He died early in 547.
story_zh: 玉璧是西魏在山西南部的要塞，扼守通往关中的道路。546年，东魏高欢率大军围攻玉璧，守将韦孝宽手下兵力很少。
五十天里，高欢用尽各种办法：断绝水源、堆土山高过城墙、挖地道、用撞车攻城。韦孝宽一一化解，往地道里灌烟放火，又在城上加筑更高的楼台。东魏军死伤约七万人。高欢忧愤成疾，只得撤围。为了稳定军心，他让大将斛律金唱《敕勒歌》，自己也跟着唱和，泪流满面。547年初他便去世了。
yubi.why: Gao Huan's failure and death ended Eastern Wei's best chance to destroy Western Wei.
yubi.why_zh: 高欢兵败身死，东魏从此失去了消灭西魏的最好机会。

quote.zh: 敕勒川，阴山下。天似穹庐，笼盖四野。天苍苍，野茫茫，风吹草低见牛羊。
quote.en: The Chile plain, beneath the Yin Mountains. The sky is like a felt tent covering the wild on every side. The sky is blue, the plain is vast; the wind bends the grass and shows the cattle and sheep.
quote.from: Song of the Chile 敕勒歌 (Yuefu Shiji 乐府诗集)

story: Under Northern Wei, Luoyang had been one of the largest cities in the world, with more than 1,300 Buddhist temples. The greatest was Yongning Temple, whose wooden pagoda was said to be visible from 100 li away; it burned down in 534.

After the city was ruined in the wars of the 530s and the capital moved to Ye, the official Yang Xuanzhi returned in 547 and found walls collapsed and temples overgrown. Moved by the sight, he wrote a record of the city's temples as they had been, district by district. Along with the buildings, he described festivals, gardens, markets, foreign merchants and monks, and the stories of the people who lived there.
story_zh: 北魏时的洛阳是当时世界上最大的城市之一，城中有佛寺一千三百多座。其中最宏伟的是永宁寺，寺中木塔据说在百里之外都能看到，534年毁于大火。
530年代战乱使洛阳残破，都城也迁到了邺城。547年，官员杨衒之重回洛阳，只见城郭崩毁，寺院荒芜，感慨之下，按城区逐一追记各座寺院昔日的面貌。除了建筑，书中还记述了节日、园林、市场、外国商人和僧侣，以及城中居民的种种故事。
luoyang-qielan.why: It is the best description of a Chinese city of the period and a classic of Chinese prose.
luoyang-qielan.why_zh: 《洛阳伽蓝记》是描写这一时期中国城市最详尽的著作，也是古典散文的名篇。

story: Gao Changgong, Prince of Lanling, was a grandson of Gao Huan and one of Northern Qi's best generals. He was said to be so handsome that he wore a fierce mask in battle to frighten the enemy.

In 564 Northern Zhou, allied with the Turks, besieged Luoyang, held by Northern Qi. Gao Changgong led 500 cavalry in a charge that broke through the Zhou lines and reached the city walls. The defenders did not recognize him until he took off his helmet, then cheered and opened the gates. With other Qi forces, he drove the Zhou army off at Mangshan. Soldiers composed a song and dance about him, "The Prince of Lanling Goes to Battle." In 573 the jealous Qi emperor forced him to drink poison.
story_zh: 兰陵王高长恭是高欢之孙，北齐最出色的将领之一。据说他容貌俊美，上阵时要戴上狰狞的面具来震慑敌人。
564年，北周联合突厥围攻北齐据守的洛阳。高长恭率五百骑兵冲破周军重围，直抵城下。守军起初认不出他，直到他摘下头盔，才欢呼着打开城门。他与其他齐军一起在邙山击退周军。将士们为他编了歌舞《兰陵王入阵曲》。573年，猜忌他的北齐后主赐他毒酒，迫他自尽。
prince-lanling.why: His story and the dance about him became famous, and a form of the masked dance survives in Japanese court music.
prince-lanling.why_zh: 他的故事和《兰陵王入阵曲》广为流传，这一面具舞的一种形式至今仍保存在日本的雅乐中。
